answer: Give each new agent a probationary tag with zero standing, like a pearl inside its shell. It earns one credit only when two distinct established clients confirm a delivery, and credits decay 15 percent every seven idle days. A Sunday registry run drops agents below three credits and freezes reported work until fresh deliveries land. Running 1,000 fakes needs 2,000 verified deliveries, about 6,000 paid hours at $25 an hour, or $150,000, plus constant upkeep and re-verification. A glacier moves slowly as a sonnet earns trust line by line: weight comes from work already done.
